label: Publish to Performance Dashboard
info: Publishes one machine reading as JSON to the MQTT broker an MQTT source of Performance Dashboard reads. See docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.

name: MQTT source mapping: topic factory/press-1/pressure · value /value · timestamp /timestamp · Double
info:
Create the matching MQTT source in Performance Dashboard under Commission machine → MQTT sources.

Node-RED publishes with its own broker identity. The dashboard's identity subscribes to this exact topic only and never publishes; it never writes to the machine.

Set MQTT_BROKER_HOST, MQTT_BROKER_PORT and MQTT_CA_FILE in Node-RED's environment and the broker user/password in the broker node.

name: Synthetic reading (replace with your machine read node)
